name: Trent McCotter
summary: Trent McCotter has run the Justice Department day to day as acting deputy attorney general since Todd Blanche became attorney general in August 2026. Blanche brought him in as principal associate deputy attorney general in April 2026, his first leadership move after Pam Bondi’s removal. A partner at Boyden Gray PLLC who argued FCC v. Consumers’ Research at the Supreme Court in 2025, he was earlier a deputy associate attorney general and a federal prosecutor. Bloomberg Law reported in August 2026 that some at the White House back him for the permanent job but worry about a hard confirmation fight.
